<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(frame):
    out={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('g','R','r') and n['pixels']>=16 and n['pixels']<=24:
            b=n['boundary']; out[n['color']]=(min(r for r,c in b),max(r for r,c in b),min(c for r,c in b),max(c for r,c in b),n['pixels'])
    return out
print('before', barstate(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':9},{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
print('after drag g->redshape', barstate(current_frame))
print('level_completed', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'done', last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(frame):
    out={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('g','R','r') and n['pixels']>=16 and n['pixels']<=24:
            b=n['boundary']; out[n['color']]=(min(r for r,c in b),max(r for r,c in b),min(c for r,c in b),max(c for r,c in b),n['pixels'])
    return out
print('before', barstate(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':9},{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
print('after drag g->redshape', barstate(current_frame))
print('level_completed', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'done', last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
